About Urvion

A magnificent event that transforms you from within - a vibrant fusion of culture and technology, talent and creativity. ECO SOCIAL CLUB's biggest on-campus festival of the year invites you aboard, where the campus turns into uncharted waters, alive with mystery and thrill.

From dazzling cultural performances to challenging technical competitions, the fest is built to engage minds and hearts alike. Whether you're competing, cheering from the crowd, or simply soaking in the atmosphere, every moment promises its own thrill.

This year, URVION sails into the world of PIRATE, where old maps run out and every horizon hides a new find. The mood turns bold, adventurous, and a little dangerous - turning the fest into a voyage unlike any other.

DAY 1 • 8 EVENT FLAGS PINNED
RULES OF THE VOYAGE

The Captain's Code

Every traveler who boards URVION must sail under the same code. Cross it, and you answer to the crew.

30-31 OCTOBER 2026
  • Shuttle services run from the ECO SOCIAL CLUB Corporate City Office (D-40, Shanti Path, Sector 7, Jawahar Nagar, Jaipur) to the venue, as per the following schedule:
    Day 1 - 30 October 2026: Bus 1 departs 10:00 AM, Bus 2 departs 2:00 PM.
    Day 2 - 31 October 2026: Bus 1 departs 10:00 AM, Bus 2 departs 2:00 PM, Bus 3 departs 5:00 PM.
    All buses arrive at the Indian Oil Petrol Pump, Transport Nagar, approximately 10 minutes after their respective departure times.
  • Passengers should report to the boarding point at least 10 minutes before departure to ensure timely boarding.
  • For queries or assistance, contact the Transport Manager, Mr. Vinod Kumar - 📞 9116035847.
  • Accommodation is available for girl students of ECO SOCIAL CLUB on a payment and first-come, first-served basis, at ₹200 per head per day for twin sharing.
  • Accommodation is also available for boys and girls participating from outside the college and outside Jaipur, at the same rate of ₹200 per head per day for twin sharing.
  • Interested students can contact Mr. Bhupendra Singh Tomar - 📞 9694097805 - before 30 October 2026 to book.
  • URVION supports both languages - some events run in English, others in Hindi. Refer to the event rulebook for language details of each event.
  • Some events run parallel to each other, so a participant can only compete in one of the events scheduled at the same time.
  • Everyone is encouraged to take part as much as they can, but you're also welcome to join purely as an audience member or spectator.
  • The registration fee is non-refundable under all circumstances, for participants and audience alike.
  • All participants and audience members must carry two forms of identification at all times - a government ID and an institutional/college ID. Failure to produce both may result in entry being barred.
FORBIDDEN
  • Carrying sharp objects, inflammable items, or any object that could threaten, harm, or injure someone is strictly prohibited. Such items will be confiscated and entry may be barred.
  • Consumption, distribution, or attempted sale or purchase of alcoholic beverages or any illegal substance is strictly prohibited.
  • Anyone found, or reasonably suspected, to be under the influence of such substances may be barred from entry or asked to leave the premises immediately.
  • All participants and the audience are expected to maintain appropriate decorum and discipline throughout every event.
  • Any act of intimidation, harassment, violence, or generally disruptive behaviour towards fellow participants, faculty coordinators, volunteers, or judges will result in immediate disqualification and expulsion from the premises.
  • Any content or language that is designed or perceived to be offensive towards any nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, language, caste, gender, or sexuality will lead to immediate disqualification.
  • The decision of the judging panel is final in all events and is not subject to further review.
  • The decision of the Management's security and discipline committee is final and is not subject to further review.
  • Once a person enters the premises, they are not allowed to leave and re-enter - re-entry will not be permitted.
  • A hand seal marks general access; a wristband marks VIP access. Every student must have the seal marked on their hand - anyone found without it will be asked to leave the campus.
